description: ForecastOS Lite is a read-only prediction-market skill for AI agents. Use it to answer questions about future events with live public market data from Polymarket, Kalshi, and Precog instead of guessing. It discovers open markets, compares market-implied probabilities, and browses upcoming Precog lau
